name: OpenAI Codex CLI
official_status_notes: Open-source CLI (Apache-2.0) for the Codex coding agent; runs in terminal and IDE extension; cloud Codex runs in sandboxes (verified Sep 2026). Includes SQLite history, MCP client support.
pricing_summary: CLI is free/open source; requires OpenAI API/Advanced subscription; usage-based API cost.
best_for: Developers who want a capable, scriptable terminal agent with OpenAI models.
strengths: Open-source CLI, agentic, sandboxing, MCP, IDE extension, supports subscription auth.
weaknesses: Model choice mainly OpenAI; long autonomous runs cost API tokens.
